# Summary

```{r summary-table}
st <- function(x) sprintf('<span class="status-%s">%s</span>', x, x)
tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(fits), function(sp) {
  f <- fits[[sp]]
  data.frame(Group = sp, Trials = nrow(f$data), z = signif(f$par[["z"]], 3),
             `95% interval of z` = ns$.interval_text(f), AIC = round(f$aic$AIC_full, 2),
             Reliability = st(attr(funresMech::reliability(f), "overall")),
             Verified = if (is.null(f$verification)) "no" else "yes", check.names = FALSE)
}))
knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", escape = FALSE)
```

```{r unverified, results = "asis"}
if (any(tab$Verified == "no") || any(grepl("fail|warning", tab$Reliability)))
  cat("<p><strong>Note.</strong> Fits that are not verified, or whose reliability checks gave warnings or failures, should not be reported without acting on the checks listed below.</p>")
```

# Model and settings

```{r model, results = "asis"}
f1 <- fits[[1]]
m <- f1$model; ctl <- f1$control
spec <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Process", "Search times", "Handling times", "Fixed parameters", "Estimation of z",
           "Trial duration", "Optimiser", "Simulated trials per density", "Generations x population",
           "Re-evaluations at each optimum", "funresMech version"),
  Value = c(m$process, paste0(m$search$name, ", mean 1/(a x^z)"), paste0(m$handling$name, ", mean h"),
            if (length(m$fix)) paste(names(m$fix), unlist(m$fix), sep = " = ", collapse = ", ") else "none",
            if (!is.null(m$fix$z)) "fixed" else f1$z_method,
            paste(f1$T, f1$time_unit), ctl$method, ctl$n_sim, paste(ctl$itermax, "x", ctl$NP),
            ctl$n_reeval, f1$version))
knitr::kable(spec, format = "html")
```

```{r per-species, results = "asis"}
for (sp in names(fits)) {
  f <- fits[[sp]]
  cat("\n\n# ", sp, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("## Estimates\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(ns$.estimates_table(f), format = "html"))
  cat("\n\n95% interval of z: ", ns$.interval_text(f), ". NLL ", sprintf("%.3f", f$nll),
      " (Monte Carlo SE ", sprintf("%.3f", f$nll_se), ").\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("## AIC\n\n")
  a <- ns$.aic_table(f); a$AIC <- round(a$AIC, 2); a[[4]] <- round(a[[4]], 2)
  print(knitr::kable(a, format = "html"))
  cat("\n\n## Reliability\n\n")
  r <- as.data.frame(funresMech::reliability(f))
  r$status <- sprintf('<span class="status-%s">%s</span>', r$status, r$status)
  print(knitr::kable(r[, c("status", "check", "detail", "action")], format = "html", escape = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n## Likelihood profile of z\n\n")
  print(ns$.plot_profile(f))
  if (!is.null(params$sims[[sp]])) {
    cat("\n\n## Functional response\n\n")
    print(ns$.plot_response(f, params$sims[[sp]]))
  }
  if (isTRUE(params$include_data)) {
    cat("\n\n## Data\n\n")
    print(knitr::kable(f$data, format = "html", col.names = c("Density", "Response")))
  }
}
```

```{r screening, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(params$screen)) {
  s <- params$screen[params$screen$flagged | params$screen$influences_dispersion, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("\n\n# Atypical trials\n\n")
  if (nrow(s)) {
    print(knitr::kable(data.frame(Group = s$species, `File row` = s$file_row, Density = s$dens,
                                  Response = s$par, `LOO probability` = signif(s$p_loo, 2),
                                  Flagged = s$flagged, check.names = FALSE), format = "html"))
  } else cat("No trial was flagged.\n")
}
```

```{r comparison, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(params$comparison)) {
  cat("\n\n# Model comparison\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(params$comparison, format = "html"))
}
```

# Reproducibility

The analysis can be repeated with the following R script.

```{r script, results = "asis"}
cat("<pre>", paste(htmltools::htmlEscape(params$script), collapse = "\n"), "</pre>")
```
